## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and the reason for this change.

## Validation

List commands and results, relevant platforms, and real-service checks that remain unverified.

## Compatibility

For plugins, state the package version, minimum host version, dependencies, permissions and catalog/lock impact.

Community contributions target **dev** from a fork. The owner may use a repository work branch. Only the owner's **dev → main** promotion is accepted into main. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/KDZZZZZZ/sesame/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
